title: VectorWorld: Efficient Streaming World Model via Diffusion Flow on Vector Graphs
summary: Rolling a driving world model forward on dense BEV rasters is expensive, which is what keeps world models out of streaming use.

title: RegFormer++: An Efficient Large-Scale 3D LiDAR Point Registration Network with Projection-Aware 2D Transformer
summary: Large-scale LiDAR registration is dominated by the cost of attention over hundreds of thousands of unordered points.

title: DifFlow3D: Hierarchical Diffusion Models for Uncertainty-Aware 3D Scene Flow Estimation
summary: Scene-flow networks return one motion vector per point and no indication of when that vector should not be trusted.

title: Unsupervised Learning of 3D Scene Flow With LiDAR Odometry Assistance
summary: Point-level motion labels for LiDAR barely exist, so supervised scene flow does not scale beyond curated datasets.

title: Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video Understanding with Disentangled Spatial-Temporal State Space Models
summary: Attention over a 4D point-cloud video costs quadratically in sequence length, which caps how much history a model can afford to look at.

title: GMF-Drive: Gated Mamba Fusion with Spatial-Aware BEV Representation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: In end-to-end driving stacks, BEV sensor fusion is usually the most expensive block in the network.

title: D^2GSLAM: 4D Dynamic Gaussian Splatting SLAM
summary: Gaussian-splatting SLAM assumes a static world, so every moving object is reconstructed as an artefact smeared across the map.

title: DifFlow3D: Toward Robust Uncertainty-Aware Scene Flow Estimation with Iterative Diffusion-Based Refinement
summary: Single-shot scene-flow regression collapses on large or ambiguous motion, and gives no signal about which predictions are unreliable.

title: 3DSFLabelling: Boosting 3D Scene Flow Estimation by Pseudo Auto-labelling
summary: Point-level 3D motion is effectively impossible to annotate by hand, so scene-flow models are trained on synthetic data and then meet real LiDAR.

title: NeuroGauss4D-PCI: 4D Neural Fields and Gaussian Deformation Fields for Point Cloud Interpolation
summary: Interpolating between two LiDAR sweeps means inventing the geometry that neither sweep observed.

title: 3-D Scene Flow Estimation on Pseudo-LiDAR: Bridging the Gap on Estimating Point Motion
summary: Scene flow is normally treated as a LiDAR problem, which leaves camera-only platforms with no way to estimate point motion at all.

title: Pseudo-LiDAR for Visual Odometry
summary: Visual odometry matches features on the image plane, where scale is ambiguous and geometry has to be recovered indirectly.

title: TransLO: A Window-Based Masked Point Transformer Framework for Large-Scale LiDAR Odometry
summary: Point transformers do not fit a full-size LiDAR scan: global attention over every point is out of reach at scan scale.

title: RegFormer: An Efficient Projection-Aware Transformer Network for Large-Scale Point Cloud Registration
summary: Large-scale registration pipelines lean on hand-designed keypoint detection and descriptors, and inherit their failure modes.

title: SFGAN: Unsupervised Generative Adversarial Learning of 3D Scene Flow from the 3D Scene Self
summary: Unsupervised scene flow usually falls back on nearest-neighbour losses, which reward motion that merely lands near some point.

title: FFPA-Net: Efficient Feature Fusion with Projection Awareness for 3D Object Detection
summary: Camera-LiDAR detectors re-project between the two sensors repeatedly, and pay for it on every forward pass.

title: 4D Auto-Labeling & Pure LiDAR 3D Detection
summary: Two eras of autonomous-driving auto-labeling: a vision-only 4D pipeline built with Hozon Auto and SJTU IRMV, then a multi-modal 4D auto-labeler and a production pure-LiDAR 3D detector at PhiGent Robotics.

title: Autonomous Lawn-Mower Robot Perception
summary: The safety-critical perception stack for a robot that has to drive itself off a transport vehicle, reach the lawn, mow it, and come back — four modules from ramp detection to an MCU-deployed BEV safety net.

title: One-Stage End-to-End Driving — 8V Pure Vision
summary: A one-stage, pure-vision end-to-end driving POC: eight surround cameras lifted into a single BEV feature, three perception heads and a Diffusion-Flow planner trained together, with no hand-designed 3D interface in between.

title: End-to-End Driving: 11V + LiDAR Fusion
summary: An end-to-end driving system fusing 11 surround cameras and LiDAR under a sparse-centric paradigm. I owned two pieces: a fused CUDA aggregation operator, and the AI planner that emits motion and planning in parallel.

title: Generative Autonomous-Driving Simulation Platform
summary: A generative simulation platform built on Cosmos-Transfer2.5: a 7-camera surround world model, real-map scenario generation, and a 4-step distilled sampler that makes surround rollouts fast enough to sit inside a closed loop.

title: Generative World Model for 7V Closed-Loop Driving Simulation
summary: A production-grade 7-camera surround-view generative world model powering closed-loop autonomous driving simulation: streaming block-causal DiT, 3-stage training with self-forcing distillation, and interactive neural rendering across complex traffic scenarios and diverse weather conditions.

title: Master's Graduation — Introduction Film
summary: A short introduction film I made for my 2023 master's graduation — a compact tour of my research focus, the labs and mentors I worked with, and the perception and 3D/4D systems I built along the way.

title: Integrated Perception, Planning, and Decision-Making Network
summary: A single end-to-end network that fuses RGB, LiDAR and infrared through attention, then jointly solves geometry–semantic mapping, unsupervised depth and odometry, detection and tracking, and closed-loop behaviour decisions.

title: J6M Static & Dynamic Perception
summary: Production perception on a mid-trim J6E / J6M platform: a static OneModel driving every static element from one shared BEV feature, a 4D-sparse model that fuses detection and tracking, and a latency-compression effort that took inference from ~42.65 ms to ~13.88 ms.

title: Controllable Surround-View Driving Generation
summary: A controllable surround-view driving generator: 3D boxes and maps become spatial conditions, text / reference frames / lanes / calibration become condition tokens, and a UNet diffusion backbone turns them into cross-camera-consistent 4V / 7V / 11V video.

title: Road Preview: Surface-Element Segmentation
summary: Road-surface perception for a road-preview ('magic-carpet') suspension feature: segment manhole covers and speed bumps reliably in the wild, then compress and quantize the model to INT8 for TDA4 edge inference.

title: 3D Scene Flow: Auto-Labeling & Production Deployment
summary: An unsupervised 3D scene-flow auto-labeler that assigns a motion vector to every LiDAR point and occupancy cell, distilled into an ultra-light production head and deployed through one ONNX graph to both TensorRT (Orin) and Horizon J6E.

title: Vector Traffic Generation & Sensor-Level Closed-Loop Simulation
summary: A two-level driving simulator: a vector world model that decides what the traffic does, and a sensor-level pipeline that decides what the cameras see — reconstruction, generated traffic, and a mask-guided video editor in one closed loop.

title: Generative Foundations: Flow Matching, Score-based Diffusion & Reinforcement Learning
summary: A systematic mathematical and engineering study across continuous normalizing flows (Flow Matching), score-based diffusion SDE/ODE dynamics, and reinforcement learning (Policy Gradient, TRPO, PPO, GAE).

title: ICML 2026 in Seoul: the shift toward real-time, closed-loop, verifiable world models
summary: Notes from ICML 2026 in Seoul, where our VectorWorld paper was a Spotlight — five signals on one-step generation, explicit structure, reward design, control theory, and automating research.

title: GE-Sim 2.0: a closed-loop video world simulator for manipulation
summary: A talk on AgiBot Genie's GE-Sim 2.0 — turning a video generator into an environment robots can actually train and test in, via a state expert, a VLM world judge, and pixel-aligned action conditioning.

title: Embodied AI, full stack: body, brain, and safety
summary: A three-part survey of embodied intelligence — robot bodies, simulators, perception and grasping; world models; and the duality of capability and risk across perceive, cognize, plan, act.

title: Full-stack autonomous driving: from sensors to control
summary: A talk through a complete AD stack — dual-brain domain control, multi-view + LiDAR perception, BEV and occupancy, online mapping, tracking, planning, control, parking, and the data flywheel.

title: One-step generative models: the MeanFlow line, paper by paper
summary: A four-paper walkthrough of He Kaiming's group compressing diffusion's hundreds of steps down to one — MeanFlow, improved iMF, drift-based modeling, and FID-as-a-loss.

title: OmniDreams: a real-time generative world model for driving
summary: A talk walkthrough of NVIDIA's OmniDreams — a causal autoregressive DiT world model that closes the loop between policy and simulation, with three-stage training to kill error accumulation.

title: 从 3DGRUT 到 ArtiFixer3D：一个“先重建、再生成、再蒸馏回 3D”的闭环
summary: Reading ArtiFixer (SIGGRAPH 2026, NVIDIA Toronto AI Lab) — an interactive 3D logic atlas of the reconstruct → generate → distill-back-to-3D loop.

title: 从互联网到物理世界：具身智能的数据革命从哪里开始？
summary: 一份关于具身智能数据采集的工作笔记——在保真·接触、规模·成本、跨本体三者难以兼得的约束下，遥操作、仿真、UMI、Ego 各自下了什么赌注。

title: 从提示词到 Agent 自动化的发展路径
summary: AI Agent 工程的四个阶段——提示词、上下文、harness、loop——不是替代关系而是嵌套关系。瓶颈每往后一层就迁移一次。

title: 机器人怎么"练"出来：在真实世界里，还是在想象里
summary: 以 RECAP / π*0.6（真实世界做 RL）和 RISE（世界模型内做 RL）为两条主线，讲清楚 VLA 为什么单靠模仿学不好、两种破局路线各自的本质与代价。
